testcase.name: days before the reference day are observed and the rest are forecast
soil temperature keeps the day's mean, min and max
no served band reports an explicit unavailability instead of a substitute
hourly readings are grouped by their own local date, not by position
the 0 to 7cm band is used when the location's model serves it
precipitation and evapotranspiration are carried through per day
soil moisture is reduced to the day's mean
a band whose units say undefined is not used even if a stray value appears
scattered null hours inside a day are dropped, not treated as zero
the 0 to 10cm band is used when 0 to 7cm is served as nulls
one unavailable variable does not suppress the ones that are served
a 23-hour daylight-saving day still reports a soil value
the reference day itself is forecast, not observed
a day with too few readings reports no soil value rather than a partial mean
